response.justification: Bogdan has strong full-stack engineering experience and exposure to AI-agent infrastructure and MCP protocols, but lacks clear evidence of 8+ years building production-grade AI solutions, direct experience with vector databases or RAG architectures, and leadership in customer-facing technical discovery — key requirements for a Staff-level GenAI role.
strengths: Experienced with AI-agent infrastructure and Model Context Protocol (MCP) tooling
Proven full-stack versatility across TypeScript, Node.js, cloud (AWS), and distributed systems
Active open-source contributor with demonstrable technical leadership and mentoring through workshops
concerns: No explicit mention of vector databases, RAG, or LLM optimization — core required technologies
AI experience appears incidental rather than focused; insufficient evidence of 8+ years in production AI systems
Limited indication of customer-facing technical leadership or enterprise cloud deployment experience
